THE HERO’S JOURNEY EXPLAINED: A BREAKDOWN OF ITS DIFFERENT STAGES
STORY STRUCTURE

The Hero’s Journey is a narrative pattern identified by Joseph Campbell, most notably outlined in his book The Hero with a Thousand Faces. This pattern of adventure and transformation is a universal one that runs through all kinds of mythic traditions across the world.

Christopher Vogler has simplified this pattern in his The Writers Journey: Mythic Structure for Writers. While Joseph Campbell’s monomyth is described to have seventeen stages, I will focus on Christopher Vogler’s version (which is divided into twelve stages) and break them down for you.

 

AN OVERVIEW
In its basic form, The Hero’s Journey follows the archetype called The Hero on his journey to achieve great deeds. All the different points on his journey is what creates the framework. The journey is divided into three parts:

Departure

Initiation

Return

 

This is a similar pattern to that of the Three Act Structure (The Setup, The Confrontation, and The Resolution). However, while the Three Act Structure focus on plot points, the focus in The Hero’s Journey lies on the stages the Hero goes through.

 

That brings us to the different stages The Hero’s Journey is divided into:

The Ordinary World

The Call to Adventure

Refusal of the Call

Meeting with the Mentor

Crossing the Threshold to the Special World

Tests, Allies and Enemies

Approach to the Innermost Cave

The Ordeal

The Reward

The Road Back

The Resurrection

Return with the Elixir

 

All of these stages are divided into the three parts I mentioned above. The first part, the Departure, include the following stages:

The Ordinary World

The Call to Adventure

Refusal of the Call

Meeting with the Mentor

Crossing the Threshold to the Special World

 

The second part, the Initiation, include the following stages:

Tests, Allies and Enemies

Approach to the Innermost Cave

The Ordeal

The Reward

 

The third part, the Return, include the following stages:

The Road Back

The Resurrection

Return with the Elixir

 

Now, let’s dive deeper into these different stages of The Hero’s Journey.

 

THE ORDINARY WORLD
The Hero is introduced. He is shown in his Ordinary World, which is nothing special and a complete contrast to the Special World he will later venture into. He has a sad, boring life that usually gets the reader to sympathize and/or identify with him.

 

THE CALL TO ADVENTURE
Within his Ordinary World, the Hero receives some form of information that shakes up the situation and acts as the call to adventure. The Hero is being prompted to leave the Ordinary World for the Special World. This is where he is beginning a new stage in his life.

 

REFUSAL OF THE CALL
The Hero experience some refusal to answer the call and turn away from the adventure, perhaps by feelings of insecurity, obligation, or fear of the unknown.

 

MEETING WITH THE MENTOR
The Hero meets a guide or protector or some form of magical helper—often a seasoned traveler—who offer the Hero training, knowledge, confidence, advice, and such that will help the Hero on his journey. The key word is that the Mentor offers help and guidance while the Hero is the one who should complete the journey.

 

CROSSING THE THRESHOLD TO THE SPECIAL WORLD
At the end of this first part, the Departure, the Hero commits to leaving the Ordinary World and crossing into the adventure and the Special World. This new unknown and dangerous world contains rules the Hero is not familiar with. While the Mentor lead the Hero to the threshold, the Hero has to cross it on his own. The threshold is also guarded by a Guardian or Gatekeeper, which means the Hero must prove to be worthy in order to pass the threshold.

 

TESTS, ALLIES AND ENEMIES
The Hero explores this new and unknown world and goes through tests and trials within this unfamiliar setting. He learns new things and skills that will prepare him for the Ordeal that’s to come. The Hero should not succeed at every test, he should know what failure feels like (because this will make him grow). He will also encounter new characters and sort out friends from foes. His new companions will help him with the tests and trials.

 

APPROACH TO THE INNERMOST CAVE
The Hero prepares for the major challenge in the Special World—together with his friends—by facing greater challenges and more difficult obstacles and guardians. This is a way to prove himself worthy of greater challenges and the ultimate battle.

 

THE ORDEAL
The Hero faces his greatest challenge yet, in the form of the Antagonist, with the knowledge and skills he has obtained up until now. He confronts death or his deepest fear. He then experiences death and rebirth (either literal or symbolic).

 

THE REWARD
The Hero takes possession of the reward/treasure he won by facing his greatest challenge, marking his triumph over the Antagonist. This reward/treasure is what the Hero went on the journey to get (it does not have to be something material, though).

 

THE ROAD BACK
The Hero is driven to complete the adventure by going back to the Ordinary World with the reward/treasure he won. It can often be as dangerous to return from the journey as it was to start it in the first place. There is often a chase scene that signals the urgency and danger of the mission, or the defeated Antagonist may be rallying for a second round.

 

THE RESURRECTION
The Hero is once again tested on the threshold going back to the Ordinary World (this may be brought about by a rebounding Antagonist who must be conquered once more). The Hero experiences a final moment of death and resurrection that’s on a higher and more complete level than the previous one, so that he is pure when he reenters the Ordinary World. This resurrection may either be literal or symbolical, and he wakes to a new world and transformed life.

 

RETURN WITH THE ELIXIR
The Hero returns home with some element of the reward/treasure that will help him improve the Ordinary World (it can just as well be a material thing as a greater insight into himself as a person). Usually, the elixir (the reward/treasure) is meant to help someone other than the Hero—what the Hero gained on his journey will benefit others beyond himself.

 

There you have the Hero’s Journey in its simplest form. I hope this post has been useful.

Have you structured your story with The Hero’s Journey as a framework? If not, would you consider using it? Please do share in the comments below.

티웨이항공이 항공기 안전규정 준수를 위해 국제선 여객기의 ‘운항불가’ 결정을 한 기장에게 정직 5개월의 징계를 한 사실이 뒤늦게 드러났다. 법원은 해당 징계의 효력을 정지하면서 “비행안전과 관련해 징계에 대한 두려움 없이 원칙에 따라 업무를 수행할 수 있는 여건이 보장될 필요가 있다”고 밝혔다.
2일 한겨레 취재와 법원 결정문을 종합하면, 경력 12년차의 티웨이항공 ㄱ 기장은 1월2일 베트남 깜라인공항서 인천공항으로 이륙을 준비하다 브레이크 문제를 발견했다. 브레이크 패드의 마모 상태를 알려주는 ‘인디케이터 핀’의 길이가 기준치 미만이었다. 그는 회사 규정인 ‘운항기술공시’ 내용대로 정비팀에 브레이크 교체를 요구했지만 이뤄지지 않았다. 이후 비행 여부에 대한 구체적 지시를 회사에 요청했지만, 별다른 조처가 없자 결국 ㄱ 기장은 운항할 수 없다고 결정했다. 이후 티웨이항공은 한국에서 부품을 공수해 베트남 현지에서 브레이크를 교체했으며, 해당 항공편에 대체항공기를 투입하느라 비행이 15시간여 지연됐다. 해당 사건 이후 회사는 인사위원회를 열어 “비행안전이 충분히 확보됐음을 충분히 설명하였음에도 운항불가를 고수하여 회사와 승객에 상당한 손해를 입혔다”는 이유로 지난 2월1일 ㄱ 기장에게 정직 5개월 처분했다.

그러나 지난달 26일 대구지법 민사20-3부(재판장 김태균)는 ㄱ 기장이 징계효력을 정지해달라며 낸 가처분신청에서 “징계효력을 정지한다”고 결정했다. 재판부는 “규정에 충실하게 브레이크 교체를 요청하고 그 조치가 이뤄지지 않아 운항불가 결정한 것이 독단적이고 무지한 판단에 따른 행위로 징계대상에 해당하는 것인지 의문이 있다”며 “다수의 생명과 신체에 대한 중대한 위험을 초래할 수 있는 비행안전과 관련하여 관계자들이 징계나 불이익에 대한 두려움 없이 원칙에 따라 업무를 수행할 수 있는 여건이 보장될 필요가 있다”고 밝혔다.
티웨이항공은 ㄱ 기장에게 비행 여부에 대한 구체적 지시를 하지 않은 것에 대해 “한국이 자정 무렵이라 회사의 업무지시가 불가능했다”고도 주장했다. 하지만 재판부는 “다수의 국제선 항공편을 운항하는 티웨이항공의 사업내용을 고려해 볼때, 그러한 주장으로 비행지시가 이뤄지지 않은 경위에 관해 충분한 해명이 된다고 보기 어렵다”고 밝혔다.

대한민국조종사노동조합연맹은 ㄱ 기장이 연맹 소속 티웨이항공조종사노동조합 위원장을 맡고 있음을 들어 징계가 부당노동행위라고 주장한다. 티웨이항공노조는 회사를 상대로 연차일정 임의변경·연차수당 미지급·비행수당 미지급 등을 두고 노동청에 진정을 냈는데, 위원장인 ㄱ 기장에 대한 징계가 이와 무관치 않다는 것이다. ㄱ 기장은 서울지방노동위원회에 부당징계·부당노동행위 구제신청을 내고 결과를 기다리고 있다. 이에 대해 티웨이항공은 한겨레에 “징계 처분의 구체적 타당성은 본안소송에서 소명할 예정”이라며 “해당 징계처분은 노조위원장 지위와는 무관하다”고 전했다.를 영어로 번역

CTU最大作用步数$K$也对所提出模型的性能产生影响。为此，本章在最大步数$K=1, 2, 3$训练了三个模型。ARLF-$i$（$i=1,2,3$）表示具有最大步数$K=i$的ARLF。如表\ref{maximum step}所示，ARLF在CTU最大作用步数$K=1$时性能最佳。随着最大步数$K$的增加，模型的率失真性能呈现下降趋势。性能下降的可能原因是对不同分布的数据进行重复滤波。即当最大步数$K$大于1时，经过神经网络模型第一次滤波后的重建图像块和原始图像块的数据特征和分布都不一样了，所以，继续使用原始重建图像块进行训练的神经网络模型对已经进行一次滤波后的图像再进行二次滤波的效果会出现偏差，导致重建质量下降。

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Optional

from datasets import Dataset, load_dataset
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer, HfArgumentParser

from trl import KTOConfig, KTOTrainer, ModelConfig, get_peft_config


# Define and parse arguments.
@dataclass
class ScriptArguments:
    """
    The arguments for the KTO training script.
    """

    # debugging
    sanity_check: Optional[bool] = field(default=True, metadata={"help": "only train on 1000 samples"})


def extract_anthropic_prompt(prompt_and_response):
    """Extract the anthropic prompt from a prompt and response pair."""
    search_term = "\n\nAssistant:"
    search_term_idx = prompt_and_response.rfind(search_term)

    if search_term_idx == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"Prompt and response does not contain '{search_term}'")

    return prompt_and_response[: search_term_idx + len(search_term)]


def get_hh(split: str, sanity_check: bool = False, silent: bool = False, cache_dir: str = None) -> Dataset:
    """Load the Anthropic Helpful-Harmless dataset from Hugging Face and convert it to the necessary format.

    The dataset is converted to a dictionary with the following structure:
    {
        'prompt': List[str],
        'completion': List[str],
        'label': List[bool],
    }

    Prompts should be structured as follows:
      \n\nHuman: <prompt>\n\nAssistant:
    Multiple turns are allowed, but the prompt should always start with \n\nHuman: and end with \n\nAssistant:.
    """
    dataset = load_dataset("Anthropic/hh-rlhf", split=split, cache_dir=cache_dir)
    if sanity_check:
        dataset = dataset.select(range(min(len(dataset), 1000)))

    flat_data = {
        "prompt": [],
        "completion": [],
        "label": [],
    }
    for sample in dataset:
        prompt = extract_anthropic_prompt(sample["chosen"])
        flat_data["prompt"].append(prompt)
        flat_data["completion"].append(sample["chosen"][len(prompt) :])
        flat_data["label"].append(True)
        flat_data["prompt"].append(prompt)
        flat_data["completion"].append(sample["rejected"][len(prompt) :])
        flat_data["label"].append(False)

    return dataset.from_dict(flat_data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = HfArgumentParser((ScriptArguments, KTOConfig, ModelConfig))
    script_args, kto_args, model_args = parser.parse_args_into_dataclasses()

    # 1. load a pretrained model
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_args.model_name_or_path)
    model_ref = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(model_args.model_name_or_path)

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_args.model_name_or_path)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    # 2. Load the Anthropic Helpful-Harmless dataset
    train_dataset = get_hh("train", sanity_check=script_args.sanity_check)

    # 3. Load evaluation dataset
    eval_dataset = get_hh("test", sanity_check=script_args.sanity_check)

    # 4. initialize the KTO trainer
    kto_trainer = KTOTrainer(
        model,
        model_ref,
        args=kto_args,
        train_dataset=train_dataset,
        eval_dataset=eval_dataset,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        peft_config=get_peft_config(model_args),
    )

    # 5. train and save the model
    kto_trainer.train()
    kto_trainer.save_model(kto_args.output_dir)

The High Intensity Heavy Ion Accelerator Facility (HIAF) is a next-generation storage-ring-based heavy-ion facility; the HIAF project is being constructed by the Institute of Modern Physics (IMP) of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and is currently under construction in Huizhou, China. The facility will be put into use by the end of 2025. HIAF is a central national research facility focused on nuclear physics, atomic physics, heavy ion applications, and interdisciplinary research. The HIAF accelerator can generate high-energy and high-intensity ion beams from protons to uranium. For example, uranium has ion beam intensities as high as 1 × 1011 ions per pulse. Multiple experimental terminals are laid out on HIAF, and there will be various particle physics and nuclear physics experiments. Therefore, for particle physics experiments and nuclear physics experiments based on the HIAF accelerator, those detectors will generate a large amount of data at a high speed. This high-throughput data from the detector's front-end electronics needs to be transferred to the back-end electronics for high-level event selection and construction. A data acquisition (DAQ) system that is high-density, scalable, and easy to upgrade is critical to simplifying data aggregation throughout the experiment. At present, most domestic DAQ systems are based on the VME (Versa Module Eurocard) standard, the CAMAC (Computer Automated Measurement and Control) standard, and the PXI (PCI Extensions for Instrumentation) standard. In these systems, data transmission adopts parallel bus mode, and the speed is limited to a few Mbps to 200 Mbps. Additionally, high complexity and large area consumption are limitations of these systems. There is a clear trend towards using high-speed serial bus as a high-speed readout and DAQ bus. Therefore, we designed a universal data acquisition unit (UDAU) as a universal control and data acquisition system for HIAF experiments. The UDAU is based on a PCI Express (PCIe) Gen 2 × 8 interface and interfaces to eight optical links via a QSFP transceiver and four SFP+ transceivers, using a Xilinx Kintex series FPGA as its central unit, combined with optical interfaces and peripheral circuitry. The UDAU can provide data transfer rates of up to 40 Gbps while being small and low-cost. As a standard design, using this UDAU can reduce the development time, production cost, and maintenance difficulty of the readout electronics system in HIAF experiments.

Monika: “There, everything’s all set for today’s meeting! All that’s missing is MC.”

Sayori: “Oh, I wonder where he could be. He’s usually the first one here.”

Natsuki: “Knowing him, he probably got caught up playing video games again.”

Yuri: “Or maybe he lost track of time reading a book. Either way, I’m sure he’ll be here soon.”

Monika: “Yeah, let’s give him a few more minutes before we start. I’m sure he wouldn’t want to miss out on discussing our latest book club pick.”

Sayori: (rubbing her belly) “Ow!”

Monika: “Sayori, are you okay? What happened?”

Sayori: “Oh, it’s just the little one starting to kick again. I think she’s excited for our meeting too!”

Natsuki: “Aww, that’s so cute! I can’t believe how close you are to your due date already.”

Yuri: “I’m sure your baby will grow up to love literature just like us. It’s never too early to start them on good books.”

Sayori: “I hope so! I can’t wait to share all my favorite stories with her. And who knows, maybe she’ll even join the literature club one day.”

Monika: “That would be wonderful! Literature has a way of bringing people together and creating lasting bonds.”

(Just then, MC walks in, looking a little flustered.)

MC: “Sorry I’m late, everyone. I got lost in a good book on the way here.”

Monika: “No worries, MC. We were just talking about how literature can bring people together.”

Sayori: “Oh, and the baby’s kicking in excitement too! Look!”

MC: “That’s so cool! I can’t wait to meet her when she’s born. And I’m excited to discuss our latest book club pick with all of you.”

Natsuki: “Well, now that everyone’s here, let’s get started! Who wants to kick things off?”

Sayori: “Was that a pun, Natsuki? Because I think our little bookworm here would approve of that!”

כשבועיים לאחר השבת השחורה (7 באוקטובר 2023), באטלר פרסמה במגזין הבריטי London Review of Books מאמר שכותרתו "המצפן של האבל"[4]. במאמר, באטלר טוענת שאין סתירה בין גינוי של מעשי חמאס באופן לא מתפשר (כפי שהיא מגנה) לבין מתן הקונטקסט ההיסטורי. היא מתייחסת אל המכתב הפתוח של קהילת האמנות לארגוני תרבות שהאשימו את פשעי ישראל נגד הפלסטינים בכל מעשה האלימות. הטיעון המרכזי של ג'ודית באטלר ב"מצפן האבל" הוא על הקשר המורכב בין אלימות לגינוי האלימות. אלה הם דבריה בהקשר לטבח:[4]

יש כאלה שמשתמשים בהיסטוריה של האלימות הישראלית באזור כדי לפטור את חמאס מאחריות, אבל הם משתמשים בצורה מושחתת של היגיון מוסרי כדי להשיג מטרה זו. בואו נהיה ברורים, האלימות הישראלית נגד פלסטינים היא מכריעה: הפצצות בלתי פוסקות, הרג של אנשים מכל הגילים בבתיהם וברחובות, עינויים בבתי הכלא שלהם, טכניקות של הרעבה בעזה ונישול בתים. והאלימות הזו, בשלל צורותיה, מתבצעת נגד עם שכפוף לכללי אפרטהייד, שלטון קולוניאלי וחוסר אזרחות. אבל כאשר ועדת הסולידריות הפלסטינית של הרווארד מפרסמת הצהרה ש"משטר האפרטהייד הוא היחיד שאשם" בהתקפות הקטלניות של חמאס על מטרות ישראליות – הוא עושה טעות. זה פסול לחלק אחריות בצורה כזו, ושום דבר לא צריך לפטור את חמאס מאחריות להרג המתועב שהם ביצעו. עם זאת, לא ראוי שקבוצה זו וחבריה יופיעו ברשימה שחורה או שיהיו מאוימים. הם בוודאי צודקים כשהם מצביעים על ההיסטוריה של האלימות באזור: "מתפיסות קרקע שיטתיות ועד תקיפות אוויריות שגרתיות, ממעצרים שרירותיים ועד מחסומים צבאיים, ומהפרדה כפויה בין בני משפחה ועד סיכולים ממוקדים, הכריחו את הפלסטינים לחיות במצב של מוות, גם איטי וגם פתאומי."

既往研究表明，哮喘组小鼠Trem2的mRNA和蛋白表达显著低于正常对照组；而与哮喘组相比，Trem2过表达组总IgE水平下降，总细胞及分类细胞数减少，与气道重塑相关的MMP-2、MMP-9、TGF-β1等因子的mRNA及蛋白表达均下调[90]。然而，Sannette等[91]的研究发现，与对照组相比，Trem2在暴露于OVA的小鼠的气道中上调，并且在肺和纵隔淋巴结中树突状细胞表达上调，这可能是由于小鼠正处于急性发作期，因此Trem2在气道和淋巴结中树突状细胞上的诱导可能旨在减少炎症防御机制受损。Wu 等[92]人使用小鼠模型表明，在急性呼吸道病毒感染期间，病毒复制会触发巨噬细胞表面的 TREM-2 表达，增加细胞内和细胞表面TREM-2的肺巨噬细胞水平，并且该作用介导CSF-1依赖性细胞存活信号，从而阻止巨噬细胞凋亡。Liu等[93]的研究表明，TREM-2对小鼠内毒素诱导的急性肺损伤的炎症反应具有保护作用，他们筛选了TREM-2基因的有效RNAi靶序列，构建了shRNA表达的慢病毒载体沉默Trem2的表达，并应用气管内滴注法感染小鼠肺组织，结果显示，与模型组相比TREM2蛋白表达水平降低，而BALF中炎性介质TNF-α和IL-10表达水平显著升高，导致肺部炎症。

研究表明，Smad 信号转导通路是 TGFβ1 介导的成纤维细胞向肌成纤维细胞分化所必需的[94,95]，而肌成纤维细胞分化需要激活 ERK 或 p38 MAPK 通路[96,97]。Yang 等人[98]报道，HGF抑制了TGFβ诱导的肌成纤维细胞活化，这依赖于ERK1/2 信号转导通路，因为 ERK1/2 磷酸化解释了 HGF 诱导的 TGFβ1 刺激的 Smad2/3 核易位和积累减少的原因。Yang等[99]的研究表明，CTGF不与Smad转导通路相互作用，而是通过激活ERK1/2来促进α-SMA蛋白的表达，并且发现没有 Smad 激活的 CTGF 的 ERK 激酶不会诱导肌成纤维细胞分化。此外CTGF 在 TGFβ1 预处理的细胞中诱导ERK1/2的激活，这表明CTGF 可能通过诱导增殖作用作用于肌成纤维细胞[100]。在施用缓激肽[204]、IL-4和IL-13[147]后，哮喘成纤维细胞中也观察到通过ERK1/2通路激活肌成纤维细胞[101]。

（2）初期のマルクスとェンゲルスは、社会主義を＜疎外された労働＞からの解放としてとらえたため、社会主義にあっては労働は人間的本質をなすものとして、疎外されない、協同の類的活動になるとする見方をとつていた。生産的労働は苦痛から喜びにかわり、自己の人間的成長と社会的存在を確認するための本来的な活動になるとされたのである。これは、フーリェの労働＝遊戯論とヘーゲルの労働＝人間本質論を統一した哲学的な社会主義観といえよう。
だが、『経済学批判要綱』での労働力商品の概念化を契機、経済原則（＝「労働一般」）と経済法則（＝「資本の生産過程」）が区別され、資本主義的生産の特殊歴史的性格が科学的に認識されてくると、先の社会主義観も修正されることになる。経済活動は人間本来の目的を追求するための手段とされ、生産的労働は短縮·節約されるべき「費用」と位置づけられることになるのである。もっとも、労働を広義に解釈し、対象化活動一般（=人間の本質的諸力の外化→主体と疎外態との緊張→自己への奪回）として把握すれば、後期マルクスは悪しき科学主義＝経済主義として批判されるかもしれない。しかし、それは人間活動一般にしめる経済活動の意義を理解しない一種の浪漫派社会主義といわなければならない。現代の「社会主義」諸国の後退現象（＝市場経済の肯定、経済効率の重視と生産力主義など）が逆說的に示しているように、社会主義の成立には、生産力の継承と労働条件の自主的決定かつ社会的労働の合理的配分が不可欠なのである。社会主義では、冷徹な眼をもって、労働日の縮減自由時間の増大が図られなければならない。”翻译为中文

Green Human Resource Management Questionnaire (GHRMPQ): This section deals with information on green human resource management practices using the Green Human Resource Management Questionnaire (GHRMPQ). The GHRMPQ contains seven sub-scales designed to measure the green human resource planning; green recruitment and selection, green training and development, green compensation management, green industrial relations, green performance management and green occupational health and safety variables. The GHRM Questionnaire was developed by Cepeda-Carrión, Ojeda-Benítez, &Aguilera-Caracuel (2021) and was adapted for the purpose of the study. The questionnaire was measured on a 4-point Likert modified response rating scale, namely: Strongly Agree (SA), Agree (A), Disagree (D) and Strongly Disagree (SD). The author reported a Cronbach alpha value of 0.78 for the questionnaire. But for the present study, a Cronbach alpha value of 0.89 was obtained for the questionnaire.
Green Human Resource Planning Scale (GHRPS): This scale was used to measure the green human resource planning in relation to business performance. The scale contains 6 items and was measured on 4 point Likert modified response rating scale, ranging from Strongly Agree (4 points); Agree (3 points), Disagree (2 points), Strongly Disagree (1 point). The author reported a Cronbach alpha of 0.75 for the scale. But for the present study, a Cronbach alpha of 0.81 was obtained.
Green Recruitment and Selection Scale (GRSS): This scale was used to measure the green recruitment and selection variable in relation to business performance. The questionnaire was measured on a 4-point Likert modified response rating scale, namely: Strongly Agree (SA), Agree (A), Disagree (D) and Strongly Disagree (SD). The author reported a Cronbach alpha value of 0.85 for the scale. But for the present study, a Cronbach alpha of 0.83 was obtained.
Green Training and Development Scale (GTDS): This scale was used to measure the green training and development variables in relation to business performance. The questionnaire was measured on a 4-point Likert modified response scale, namely: Strongly Agree (SA), Agree (A), Disagree (D) and Strongly Disagree (SD). The author reported a Cronbach alpha value of 0.81 for the scale. But for the present study, a Cronbach alpha of 0.86 was obtained.
Green Compensation Management Scale (GTDS): This scale was used to measure the green compensation management variable in relation to business performance. The scale covers a standard, broad, spectrum and practical measure on compensation management variable. The questionnaire was measured on a 4-point Likert modified response scale, namely: Strongly Agree (SA), Agree (A), Disagree (D) and Strongly Disagree (SD). The author reported a Cronbach alpha value of 0.74 for the scale. But for the present study, a Cronbach alpha of 0.78 was obtained.
Green Performance Management Scale (GTDS): This scale was used to measure the green performance management variable in relation to business performance. The scale covers a standard and practical measure on performance management variable. The questionnaire was measured on a 4-point Likert modified response scale, namely: Strongly Agree (SA), Agree (A), Disagree (D) and Strongly Disagree (SD). def create_material(name, diffuse_color, texture):
    material = rt.StandardMaterial()
    material.name = name

    material.diffuse = rt.color(diffuse_color[0], diffuse_color[1], diffuse_color[2])

    bitmap = rt.Bitmaptexture()
    bitmap.filename = texture

    material.diffuseMap = bitmap
    material.Specular_Level = 100

    selection = rt.selection
    for obj in selection:
        if rt.isvalidnode(obj):
            obj.material = material

    return material

def create_dummy_from_selected_object(name):
    if name:
        MaxPlus.Core.EvalMAXScript(maxscript_code)

        rt = pymxs.runtime
        coords = rt.face_centers
        coords = get_average_coordinates(coords)

        dummy = MaxPlus.Factory.CreateDummyObject()
        dummy_node = MaxPlus.Factory.CreateNode(dummy)
        dummy_node.Position = MaxPlus.Point3(coords[0], coords[1], coords[2])
        dummy_node.SetWorldScale(MaxPlus.Point3(0.015, 0.015, 0.015))
        dummy_node.SetName(name)

        rt.clearSelection()
        dummy_node.Select()

def get_average_coordinates(lista):
    num_coords = len(lista)
    add_x = sum(coords[0] for coords in lista)
    add_y = sum(coords[1] for coords in lista)
    add_z = sum(coords[2] for coords in lista)

    promedio_x = add_x / num_coords
    promedio_y = add_y / num_coords
    promedio_z = add_z / num_coords

    return [promedio_x, promedio_y, promedio_z]

请将“本稿において検討を加えてきた労働経済論は、その脈絡のなかで重要な提起をおこなってきたように思う。とりわけ隅谷氏に明確なように、経済学のもつ客観主義を克服するという鋭い問題意識は、はじめて公然と労働力商品の論理によって賃労働(者)のことを説くことから派生する負の面を明らかにしようとした。だが労働経済論-賃労働理論は多くの重要な提起を残したにもかかわらず資本主義的生産そのものを経済学的に認識してしまうことによって、生産の内部にある賃労働の諸相をみる方向性を喪失させたのである。

資本主義的な生産と労働の総体をつらぬく一本の軸が、生産過程=価値増殖過程であるとすれば、もう一本の軸は労働過程である。この二本の軸が矛盾的対立をもちながらも二重化するところに、資本主義の生産労働過程はつくりだされる。逆からみれば、資本主義的生産の総体を、生産労働過程という視点からとらえていくとき、賃労働の側からみた資本主義の姿がみえてくる。

資本主義的生産そのものを、賃労働主体の展開の場所として考察しなおすこと、本稿のはじめに述べた理論と実践の結合を遂げるには、まず理論自身が賃労働にとって主体的な理論として創造されなおさなければならないのである。それにはまず、労働力商品という範疇から資本主義生産の総体をとらえる経済学の論理に、労働自身の存在、実践の論理を対置させていくことが必要になるように思われる。そこから新らしい資本主義的生産の総体を認識しうる理論が形成されねばならない。



(1)その結果、資本主義そのものを主体的に分析しなおすことなしに、革命の問題が考察された。そこから主体の問題を前衛の問題にすりかえるという伝統的な誤りが生みだされていったのである。

(2)細見氏の『資本論』研究からは、結局資本主義の否定の契機が賃金労働の内的構造からは説明されないことになる。労働者の主体を歴史過程のなかで不断に再生産されていくものとしてではなく、超歴史的に措定してしまう戦後主体性論争の弱点が克服されていない。その結果主体の問題が自覚の論理に求められていくという、きわめて梯明秀氏の経済哲学的色彩があらわれてくる。たとえば「マルクス・コンメンタール『経済学哲学草稿』」(『現代の理論』一九七一年七月)では次のように述べられる。「マルクスの疎外論は、こうした自覚-現実の矛盾の運動そのものによって覚醒された自覚と、立脚点とするものでありました」。重要なことは「覚醒された自覚」ではなく「現実の矛盾の運動そのもの」を賃労働の存在と実践として解き明かすことだと考えるのが私の立場である。

הרצל ומירב חג'אג' ניסו לחסום את מעבר היתומים העזתים: "איבדתם את זה לגמרי. ביזיון"
הרצל ומירב חג'אג', הוריה של סגן שיר הי"ד, ניסו למנוע הערב את מעבר שיירת האוטובוסים שהובילה את היתומים מעזה.
ההורים השכולים הרצל ומירב חג'אג' ניסו לחסום הערב (שני) את האוטובוסים שהובילו את היתומים העזתים ליהודה ושומרון.

ההורים ירדו לכביש וניסו למנוע את מעבר האוטובוסים וניידות המשטרה שליוו אותם. מירב זעקה: "בושה, ביזיון. תתביישו לכם, אין לכם בושה? איבדתם את זה לגמרי. ילדים של מחבלים".

הערב חשף ח"כ אחמד טיבי כי חלק מהילדים היתומים הם לכאורה בנים של מחבלים שחוסלו על ידי צה"ל במהלך הלחימה בעזה.

טיבי כתב, "אלה ילדים שישראל הרגה/רצחה את ההורים שלהם ולכן הם יתומים. הם לא מועברים לתל אביב אלא לגדה המערבית".

עמית סגל, שחשף את העברת העזתים לישראל, הגיב לטיבי, "בניכוי רטוריקה אנטי ישראלית חריפה, טיבי חושף פה דבר מטלטל: ישראל מסייעת לבני משפחות של מחבלים שחיסלה כמחווה הומניטרית, בעוד חטופינו נמקים במנהרות. בושה, בושה, בושה".

על פי הדיווח, במסגרת המבצע, היתומים מבית היתומים SOS שהפסיק לתפקד ברצועת עזה, עברו בתוך ישראל, כולל בפאתי ירושלים.

המטה לביטחון לאומי במשרד ראש הממשלה אישר להעביר את הקבוצה, שבה גם עשרות מלווים בוגרים עזתיים אל ביתם החדש בבית לחם.

המחווה ההומניטרית החריגה הייתה לבקשת שגרירות גרמניה, ונעשתה על אף שחמאס ששולט על הרצועה אינו מוכן לנקוב אפילו בשם החטופים החיים ובמספרם.

על פי הדיווח כוחות גדולים של צה"ל גויסו לצורך מבצע ההעברה לאורך ציר התנועה ממעבר טאבה ועד לכביש המנהרות, כדי לאפשר לאוטובוסים של היתומים ומלוויהם לעבור בבטחה לשטחי הרשות הפלסטינית.

The structure of Shadanakar (a vast area of investigation that we shall soon enter) will remain unintelligible at the most basic of levels if the meaning of the words suprapeople, metaculture, and transmyth is not firmly grasped beforehand.

The term suprapeople refers to a group of nations united by a common, jointly created culture, or to an individual nation, if that nation alone has created a culture that has reached a high level of distinction and maturity. It goes without saying that completely isolated cultures do not exist. Cultures interact with each other. But on the whole each culture is entirely unique and, despite the influence it exerts on other cultures, it remains, in all its fullness, the achievement of only one suprapeople, which is its creator.

It would not be necessary to introduce the suprapeople concept if it did not possess metahistorical, as well as historical, significance. Its metahistorical significance rests in the fact that the distinctiveness of a suprapeople is not limited to its own cultural sphere of influence in Enrof but also affects many variomaterial planes, both of ascent and descent, for certain parts of those planes are subject to the activities of one suprapeople alone. One should bear in mind that the term suprapeople not only includes those individuals, our contemporaries, who belong to it now. A great many of those who belonged to it earlier, even at the very dawn of its history, and who afterward, in the afterlife, have acted and act now on transphysical planes linked to that suprapeople. A staircase of planes common to all suprapeoples rises above humanity, but the complexion, landscape, and function of each plane varies above each suprapeople. There are even planes that only exist above a single suprapeople. The exact same is true of the demonic worlds of descent, which exist, as it were, beneath suprapeoples. Thus, a significant portion of Shadanakar consists of individual multiplaned segments. In each of those segments the Enrof plane is occupied by only one suprapeople and its culture. Those multiplaned segments of Shadanakar are called metacultures.

Every suprapeople has its own myth, which does not take shape in the culture's infant stage alone. Since the traditional use of the word myth does not match the meaning attached to it here, it is necessary to explain carefully in what sense I use the word.

When we speak of a tightly integrated system of rich symbols that embody some comprehensive international teaching and that find expression in legends and ritual, in theology and philosophy, in monuments of literature and art, and lastly, in a moral code, we are speaking of myths of the great international religions. There are four such myths: Hindu, Buddhist, Christian, and Muslim.

When we speak of a tightly integrated system of rich symbols that define the relationship of one suprapeople to Enrof and to the transphysical and spiritual worlds, a system molded into a definite religion that has played an enormously significant role in the history of the given suprapeople but has rarely spread beyond its boundaries, we are speaking of national religious myths of individual suprapeoples. Such are the Egyptian, ancient Iranian, Jewish, Germanic, Gallic, Aztec, Incan, Japanese, and some other myths.

When we are referring to symbols just as rich and perhaps also tied, although not as closely, to ideas of a religious and moral nature, which, though they have not evolved into a strictly formulated system, reflect, nonetheless, a group of common moral, transphysical, metahistorical, or cosmic truths in connection with the specific nature and role of that culture, we are dealing with shared myths of suprapeoples. Such are the myths of the South-Western (Roman Catholic) suprapeople, the North-Western (Germanic Protestant) suprapeople, or the Russian suprapeople. In some cultures, the Greco-Roman or Babylonian-Canaanite, for example, their myths had already passed the “shared” stage of development but did not take shape in a system strictly formulated enough to allow the Olympic or Babylonian myths to be numbered among the national religious myths of suprapeoples.

Last is the fourth and final group – shared national myths. They are myths of individual ethnic groups within a suprapeople that have created, as a supplement to the shared suprapeople myth, their own particular, very restricted variations of that myth, variations that have not evolved into any strictly formulated system or religion. One could cite as examples the pagan myths of the Slavic tribes, the Finnish tribes, the Turkish tribes, as well as the myths of some isolated and primal tribes in India. Ethnic myths in their embryonic state can be observed among many ethnic groups, but they rarely achieve any clear expression.

We will not use the word myth in reference to any other phenomenon in the history of culture.

The last three groups of myths are concerned with one specific culture. The first group – the myths of international religions – are (with one exception) mystically linked to planes in Shadanakar above those segmented sections called metacultures.

It seems to me that the concept of national religious myths can be grasped without too much difficulty. As for the shared myths of suprapeoples, for the sake of clarity, a pair of supplementary definitions are in order.

Defined inductively, the shared myth of a suprapeople is the sum of its beliefs concerning the transphysical cosmos and the part the given culture and each self belonging to that culture play within it The culture elaborates these beliefs, molding them into cycles of religious-philosophical ideas, iconography, social-moral systems, state-political institutions, and cycles of national lifestyle manifested in ritual, daily routines, and tradition.

Defined deductively, the shared myth of a suprapeople is an awakening by the suprapeople, in the person of its most creative representatives, to a second reality above them, of which the suprapeople is a part and in which the direction of its growth and the roots of its fate are hidden. This awakening is made groggy by additives foreign to it issuing from unattuned human nature. We can give that second reality, which serves as the object of transphysical, metahistorical, artistic, and philosophical apprehensions, the provisional name of transmyth.

It goes without saying that the discrepancy between myth and transmyth can vary considerably. The limitations of those who apprehended the transmyth through intuition, dreams, artistic inspiration, religious meditation, or metahistorical enlightenment; the national, temporal, class, and individual peculiarities of their conscious and subconscious minds (the latter playing an active part in the process); the impossibility of finding words or three-dimensional images to convey precisely the reality of variodimensional worlds – can not all that lead to countless aberrations, to the cluttering of the myth with a mass of chance, inaccurate, anthropomorphic, simplistic, and even simply wrong ideas? But myths are dynamic. They exist in time, evolving and changing in appearance, and their later phases, as a rule, approach more closely the transmyth, because the minds that apprehend it have over the centuries become subtler, richer, keener, and broader.

But in the meantime, the transmyth is also evolving. The reality behind our reality is seething with movement, and there can be no question of it remaining static.         .Duress and Undue Influence
When negotiating a contract the parties must have been acting free of the threat of force (e.g. with a gun in one ear) and free of the unjustifiable influence of those who have power or authority over them. The use of threat of force is called duress and it prevents the formation of a contract, although some people argue that a contract is made but it is voidable. Undue influence does make contracts voidable. If the parties have a "special relationship" (e.g. doctor and patient, solicitor and client) then any contract between them will be assumed to have been the result of undue influence, and therefore voidable- unless the stronger party can rebut the presumption. He might show, for example, that independent advice was taken by the weaker party. Where no such relationship exists undue influence must be proved. It will not be presumed.

تحية طيبة لعشاق ألعاب الفيديو ومحبي الإصدارات الكلاسيكية، خاصة جهاز PlayStation 3 الذي حقق شعبية كبيرة وقدم مكتبة ضخمة من الألعاب المثيرة والمتنوعة. إذا كنتم ترغبون في استعادة تجربة اللعب على PS3 ولكن هذه المرة على الكمبيوتر الشخصي، لدينا خبر سار لكم. يمكنكم الآن إعادة عيش تلك الذكريات الرائعة والاستمتاع بألعاب PlayStation 3 المفضلة لديكم على الكمبيوتر بفضل تقنيات المحاكاة المتقدمة.
في هذه المدونة، سأقدم لكم دليلاً شاملاً حول كيفية إعداد وتشغيل محاكي PlayStation 3 المعروف بـ RPCS3 على جهاز الكمبيوتر بسلاسة. ستتمكنون من الانغماس في ألعاب مميزة مثل “The Last of Us”، “Uncharted”، و “Metal Gear Solid 4”، وذلك بجودة رسومات محسنة وباستخدام ميزات لم تكن متاحة في الجهاز الأصلي.

شاهدوا الفيديو التالي للحصول على دليل خطوة بخطوة حول تشغيل ألعاب PS3  على الكمبيوتر:



اتبعوا الخطوات التالية للبدء:

1.      تحميل المحاكي RPCS3: يعتبر RPCS3 أحد أفضل محاكيات PS3، يتيح لكم تشغيل الألعاب بكفاءة عالية وبمرونة كبيرة في الإعدادات.


2.      تحميل ملف التحديثات: Firmware لكي يعمل المحاكي بشكل صحيح، ستحتاج إلى ملفات Firmware الخاصة بجهاز PS3. يمكن استخراج هذه الملفات من جهاز PS3 الخاص بكم أو البحث عنها عبر الإنترنت.

بعد تنزيل المحاكي والحصول على الألعاب المطلوبة، ستحتاجون إلى إعداد المحاكي بشكل صحيح لضمان التوافق الأمثل مع الألعاب المختارة.
نتمنى أن تجدوا في هذا الدليل ما يفيدكم في العودة إلى استكشاف عوالم ألعاب PlayStation 3 الساحرة والتمتع بتجارب لا تُنسى. دعونا نشارك هذه الذكريات ونعيد إحياء تلك اللحظات الجميلة مع جيل جديد من اللاعبين.

restructure this: Unscientific points in the Gita.

 It was widely believed by the Hindus of older days that the earth is flat. And there is a mountain by the name ‘Meru Parvata’ which, surrounds the earth from all sides. The sun circumambulates around that mount. Thus completing its rotation around the earth. And that mountain ‘Meru’ is supposed to be the biggest mountain in the world. It is mentioned in the Gita that the main speaker (supposed to be Krishna) is giving all the possible superlative examples to express his greatness. One among them goes as follows… Gita 10:23 “Of all the Rudras I am the Lord Shiva, of the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am the Lord of wealth (Kubera {remember, the lender to god Venkateswara}), of the Vasus, I am fire (Agni), and of mountains, I am Meru.” As a matter of fact, Meru is a hypothetical mountain, which doesn’t exist. If Krishna was god or if the Gita was a word of god, how came, this mistake has crept in? Further, there was an unscientific belief among the Hindus, which we want to expose directly with an example. In Chapter 10 Krishna commits a mistake while boasting about himself with all possible superlative expressions. Please go through Gita 10: 31, “Of purifiers, I am the wind; Rama of the warriors I; and I am Makara (crocodile) of fishes; of streams, Ganga I am.” No wonder, the unscientific community did not know in those days that, Makara (crocodile) is not a fish but a reptile. Even if we give lenience to the classification that all the creatures living in water are fish only, none of them will be called as a reptile. Still, the crocodile is neither the largest of the fish nor is it the most ferocious. As a matter of fact, it makes us feel that the author of the Gita has never sailed across the ocean. Otherwise, he is bound to know about the other ferocious, powerful and large fishes. The reason behind assuming the absence of such exposure to sailing is one of the basic beliefs in Hinduism that, ‘The man who crosses the sea will become outcaste!’ In fact, some scholars opine that Rama (the hero god of Ramaayana) opted to build a bridge to Lanka to fight with Raavana (the kidnapper of his wife), instead of sailing across! (Please wait for Rama’s Character Certificate to throw some good light on this guy Rama.) Error no.10: As we have already seen under the article ‘beliefs’, the Hindus believe that the moon is the husband of all the stars. They fail to realize the reality in comparison. Here, in the Gita, we find Krishna boasting about himself, saying… Gita 10:21 “Of Adityas, I am Vishnu, of lights I am the radiant sun, of the Maruts, I am Marici, and among the stars, I am moon.” The ancient Hindus fail to realize the fact that, the moon, no doubt appears to be very big from the earth, but, it remains just a satellite. It is much smaller than the earth also. Further, the earth itself is very small in comparison to the sun about 400 times, roughly. Then, the sun is just a mediocre star. Then, logically, saying, ‘I am moon among the stars’ is like saying, ‘I am ant among elephants!’

假设你是个资深的经济学加，以下这段话有没有问题：假定有两个国家，A国和B国，A国是富国，其人均GDP是B国的十倍。

十倍代表什么意思，代表着A国和B国在可贸易品领域，拥有着十倍的劳动生产率差距。

举例来说，假定A国平均1人月能生产10台汽车，而B国1人月只能生产1台汽车。那么在贸易时，A国1个人月的劳动就可以换取B国10个人月的劳动。

当然真实情况要复杂的多，10倍的劳动差更多体现在先进科技领域。但无论A国还是B国，从事科技研发的人们，占比肯定是少数。更多的人其实在不可贸易的服务业，比如卡车司机，理发师，餐厅服务员等。

虽然A国的理发师和B国的理发师提供完全一样的劳动，但由于各自在各自国家的封闭市场里进行劳动交换，A国理发师的服务对象是A国的富裕科技人员，所以，从货币上看，A国理发师收入也是B国理发师的十倍。

但这只是货币价格的幻象，A国理发师并没有比B国富裕十倍，因为货币是要看购买力的。A国的所谓富裕，只是体现在购买可贸易的工业品上（比如手机，电脑等）。而一旦涉及到服务业，就是我的时间换你的时间，大家本质没区别。

所以，虽然人均GDP相差10倍，真实的生活品质相差，连1倍都没有，如果A国恰好处于老龄化而B国在人口红利，那么在B国的生活品质，其实是反超A国的。

TREM2 表达水平在 IPF 患者和 BLM 诱导的肺纤维化小鼠的肺部显著升高。生物信息学分析显示，TREM2表达较高的IPF患者生存时间较短，且TREM2表达与成纤维细胞和M2巨噬细胞密切相关。另外，单细胞RNA测序分析显示，TREM2主要在巨噬细胞中表达，差异表达基因与炎症反应、细胞外基质（ECM）和胶原形成有关。Thomas等也发现了一个高度特异性的巨噬细胞群体，在肝和肺纤维化中表达 TREM2 和/ CD9 的“瘢痕相关巨噬细胞”，定义为纤维化进展和消退的关键效应细胞 （7， 10）。研究发现，在TH2免疫反应过程中，IL-4 刺激 M2 巨噬细胞极化后，TREM2 表达增加，导致 STAT6 激活、TGF-β 表达升高和成纤维细胞间接激活。而TREM2 沉默可以抑制 M2 巨噬细胞浸润并阻断 STAT6 激活。此外，TREM2沉默还降低了小鼠肺组织中TGF-β的表达水平，抑制成纤维细胞向肌成纤维细胞的分化，导致促纤维化因子PDVF 和 Fizz1的分泌减少，并间接影响了成纤维细胞对Fib、Col I和α-SMA等纤维化因子的产生，减轻肺损伤和纤维化。然而，Mamatali等在肺纤维化模型小鼠的研究发现，间充质干细胞治疗通过分泌ANGPTL4等效应器，导致Trem2抗炎巨噬细胞-4亚群在肺组织中显著增加，通过降低blm诱导的PF的促炎反应，抑制了纤维化进程。

根据这段内容，用一句话总结TREM2在肺纤维化作用。

请将“「上部構造」であって「経済外」でなく、「支配」はあるが「強制」はなく、「法治国」でもないのに「警察」がいて、「『法の支配』を監視し、執行する」。しかもこの「不透明」そのものの「純粋」資本主義社会の「法秩序」は、「被支配階級を抑圧する道具としての国家」ではない「夜警国家」によって「維持されねばならぬ「必然性」をもっている。それでも私は「原理論からの国家論の展開を拒否」してる!

ようするに、「法の支配」が「経済外的強制」だったら、もちろ降旗氏はまちがっていることになり、そしてまた、降旗氏が『資本論』の一言半句にしがみついて「経済関係の反映」としての法を語り、同様に宇野氏の一言半句にしがみついて「経済的関係の『内容』を規制」しないかぎりでの法に固執しつづけるとしたら、「低俗なひまつぶし」はおやめになるよう忠告するほかないというだけのことである。なぜなら、こうした「経済学原理論」のいいかえにすぎない、無内容そのものの「法規定」を媒介に、経済学と国家論接ぎ木を試みるというのが、「宇野派の人達」の「内にむかっての国家」論の正体であったからである。

複雑な軌跡をたどったのち、ようやく「宇野理論の根本」にめぐあった降旗氏は、「私見によればそんな原理(ブルジョア国家の原理―引用者)はもともと存在しない」(本十二号五二頁)などと多少の余裕さえみせる。そのうえで「資本主義社会は近代的統一国家形成を媒介とすることなくしては存在しえなかった。……それは権力機構としてはまず絶対主義の家産国家として出発」したというのである。

「今や国家の原理的解明は不可能だ」(同)とか、「原理論の内部から国家論を展開しようとする岩田式主張は完全に封殺されている」(同五三頁)とか、はしゃぎまわるのも結構だが、それはちょっとフェアではないのではないか。なぜなら、岩田氏は、降旗氏が原理論と「法の支配論」の境界をさまよっていた、その同じ本誌三号で、「宇野さんのいう段階論の側から国家論をとく」というもう一つの国家論を、すでに展開しているのである。それを無視して、しかも四年近くもたってから、べつに「私見」でもなんでもない「宇「野氏の意見」の断片をいくつか並べて、「勝利の宣言」とは少々虫が良すぎはしないだろうか。

ところで降旗氏は「資本家的生産様式の確立・純化の過程をとおして、はじめてこの生産様式に対する科学的解明の基礎が与えられるように、資本主義的国家に対する解明は、まずこのスタトとして絶対主義国家によってその素材を与えられることになる」(本誌十二号五二頁傍点引用者)という見解を述べている。こもこの「ように」という言葉の意味は重要である。なぜなら、自由主義段階の資本主義を基礎に確立する原理論と、重商主義段階に現われる絶対主義国家を素材とする国家論とを、なんで対応関係におくことができるのか、という問題を提起するからである。

降旗氏が「官僚制と常備軍に支えられた中央集権国家権力が・・・・・・一九世紀中葉において『純粋資本主義国の典型』をなしたイギリスにおいて、まさにその両者が欠落している」(本誌三号四二頁)などという聞きかじりの誤った知識を改め、「やはり資本主義の純粋な発展過程と対応した上部構造は『官僚的・軍事的国家機構』たりえなかった」(同)などという思い込みを変えないかぎり、回答を得ることはできないであろう。”翻译为中文

import json
import pandas as pd
import cv2
from thefuzz import fuzz
from thefuzz import process
import numpy as np

def read_textract_output(csv_path):
    return pd.read_csv(csv_path)

def read_json_entities(json_path):
    with open(json_path, 'r') as file:
        return json.load(file)
    
def find_entity_bounding_boxes(entity_text, textract_df, image_size):
    entity_tokens = entity_text.split()
    results = pd.DataFrame()

    for token in entity_tokens:
        choices = textract_df["text"].dropna().tolist()
        best_match, score = process.extractOne(token, choices, scorer=fuzz.token_sort_ratio)
        if score > 70:
            best_matches_df = textract_df[textract_df["text"] == best_match]
            results = pd.concat([results, best_matches_df])

    bounding_boxes = []
    try:
        # Sort by line and word number to cluster words that are on the same line
        sorted_results = results.sort_values(by=["line_num", "word_num"])

        # Group the resulting bounding boxes by line number
        grouped_results = sorted_results.groupby("line_num")

        for _, group in grouped_results:
            # Calculate scaling factors based on image size and original image dimensions
            image_width, image_height = group.iloc[0]["image_width"], group.iloc[0]["image_height"]
            scale_x = image_size[0] / image_width
            scale_y = image_size[1] / image_height

            # Calculate the bounding box for the whole line
            min_left = np.min(group["left"])
            min_top = np.min(group["top"])
            max_right = np.max(group["left"] + group["width"])
            max_bottom = np.max(group["top"] + group["height"])
            bbox = (min_left * scale_x, min_top * scale_y, (max_right - min_left) * scale_x, (max_bottom - min_top) * scale_y)
            bounding_boxes.append(bbox)
            
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

    return bounding_boxes
        
def draw_bounding_boxes(image_path, entities, textract_df):
    image = cv2.imread(image_path)
    image_size = image.shape[1], image.shape[0]

    for category, details in entities.items():
        if category == "invoice_details" or category == "Payment Details" or category == "amounts_and_tax":
            for entity, value in details.items():
                if value:
                    bounding_boxes = find_entity_bounding_boxes(value, textract_df, image_size)
                    try:
                        for bbox in bounding_boxes:
                            x, y, w, h = map(int, bbox)
                            cv2.rectangle(image, (x, y), (x + w, y + h), (0, 255, 0), 2)
                    except:
                        pass
        else:
            pass

    cv2.imwrite('/home/ritik1s/Desktop/bbox_issues/temp_GPT/annotated_invoice.jpg', image)

肺部炎症性疾病是指发病机制与炎症相关的肺部疾病，如急性肺损伤(acute lung injury, ALI)、肺炎、哮喘、慢性阻塞性肺疾病(chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, COPD)和肺纤维化等[1, 2]。在感染期，固有免疫系统和适应性免疫系统会诱发炎症反应，通过炎症反应可以清除大多数感染。感染无法及时清除就会导致慢性炎症[3]。炎症是一把双刃剑，一方面可以清除病原体，促进组织修复；另一方面，免疫系统过度的免疫反应过程中释放的炎性物质也会损伤正常组织，促进炎症反应。免疫系统炎症反应紊乱与肺部炎症性疾病的发生和发展密切相关[4]。程序性死亡配体 1 (programmed cell death-ligand 1, PDL1)是一种免疫检查点蛋白，其与程序性死亡受体1 (programmed death 1, PD-1)结合可抑制 T 细胞及其它免疫细胞的活性，调节免疫平衡。在肺部疾病中，TREM2 的表达受炎症因子等多种因素调控。研究发现，ALI [5, 6]、哮喘[7, 8]、COPD [9]和特发性肺纤维化(idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, IPF) [10, 11]等疾病中，PDL1 的表达普遍增加，并且与疾病的发展和预后密切相关。本文主要对 PDL1 在 ALI、COPD、哮喘、IPF 等肺部炎症性疾病中的作用机制和可能的临床意义进行综述。

请将“第一節　純粋な認識と経験的な認識の違いについて


001　経験なしでは何も始まらない

わたしたちのすべての認識は経験とともに始まる。これは疑問の余地のないところだ。認識能力が対象によって呼び覚まされて活動し始めるのでなければ、そもそも何によって動き始めるというのだろうか。対象はわたしたちの感覚を触発するが（４）［対象が感覚に働きかける道は二つあり］、対象みずからが感覚のうちに像を作りだすか（５）、人間の知性［＝悟性］のもつ能力に働きかけるのである（６）。働きかけられた知性は、対象の像を比較し、これらを結びつけたり分離したりすることによって、感覚的な印象という生なまの素材から、対象の認識そのものを作りあげるのであり、この活動が経験と呼ばれる。だからわたしたちのうちの認識において、時間的にみて、経験に先立つものは何もない。すべてが経験とともに始まるのである。


002　認識は合成されたものである

このようにわたしたちのすべての認識が経験とともに始まるとしても、すべての認識が経験から生まれるわけではない。というのも経験によって生まれた認識というものですら、一つの合成物であると考えられるからである。［この合成物を構成しているものは二つあるが、その］一つはわたしたちが［感覚的な］印象によって受けとったものであり、もう一つはわたしたちに固有の認識能力がみずから作りだしたものである（この作用において感覚的な印象は、［認識を作りだすための］たんなるきっかけの役割をはたすだけである）。ところでわたしたちは、長いあいだの訓練によって、認識が合成物であることに注目し［印象に付加されたものを］巧みに分離することができるようにならなければ、この［付加されたものを、感覚的な印象という］土台となる素材から分離することができないのである。


003　アプリオリとアポステリオリ

　ここで問いたいのは、経験から独立した認識というものが、すなわち何よりも感覚のすべての印象から独立した認識というものが、存在するかどうかということである。しかしこの問いは、少なくとも詳細に研究せずにすぐに解決できるようなものではない。ところでこのように経験から独立して生まれる認識を、アプリオリな認識と呼んで、経験的な認識と区別することにしよう。経験的な認識の源泉はアポステリオリである（７）。すなわち経験のうちにその源泉があるのである。
”翻译为中文

我是慈善信托助力乡村振兴法治化的优化路径探讨——基于十省百村的实践调研项目的成员，实地调研了江苏省苏州市吴中县东山村，根据我的调研内容写一份个人心得，至少500字
访谈中所出现的问题反思和改善建议——
问题反思：
1. 项目理解程度假设不到位：虽然提前和村委会沟通并提前让村民对访谈问题有了初步了解，但实际上未完全考虑到村民的受教育程度，比如村民可能并不理解慈善信托的具体概念。实际过程中需要进一步说明和宣传。
2. 服务内容的深度了解：虽然村民能够概括服务带来的正面影响，但在描述具体服务细节方面存在缺口，需要在访谈时加以引导，更细致地探讨服务细节。
3. 受访者舒适度的重视：在询问个人生活和感受时，可能涉及隐私，需要提前确保受访者的舒适度。

改善建议：
1. 加强教育推广：通过故事或者和简化的解释，加强对慈善信托概念的宣传和教育，提高受访谈村民的项目理解度。
2. 深入具体服务细节调研：更系统地记录和了解项目中提供的具体服务，包括服务频次、种类和受益者的详尽反馈。
3. 保护隐私和体恤受访者：确保访谈在尊重个人隐私和个人感受的前提下进行，创造安全开放的谈话环境。
4. 持续关注与反馈机制建立：为村民提供定期联系反馈渠道，以在本次调研过程中、后持续收集项目运行中的意见和建议。
5. 关注非受益村民的意见：可以拓宽访谈对象，包括未直接受益的村民，以获取更广泛的视角和全面的反馈。
访谈结果总结与分析——
总体来看，访谈结果表明“苏信颐家”项目已经取得了初步成功，同时也指出了未来改进和发展的方向。
1. 村民对项目认知度不高，但认可度高：村民尽管不完全理解慈善信托的具体运作细节，但普遍知道“苏信颐家”项目，也知悉项目运作公司，同时能够感受到其带来的正面影响。这意味着企业社会责任的履行得到了村民的认可，展示了企业参与乡村振兴项目的积极作用。这同时表明政府需要通过各种渠道，尤其是通过村委会和项目工作人员，提供针对慈善信托的概念和意义进一步宣传教育，以提高项目的透明度和村民的参与感。
2. 村民服务体验较好：作为服务受益者，参与的村民对所接受的居家护理服务表示满意，尤其是在改善生活质量和减轻家庭负担方面。具体服务包括定期的身体检查、生活照料和协助完成日常任务。
3. 项目意义与乡村振兴效果起到协同作用：在乡村振兴的框架内，该项目能有效推动农村的社会福祉、改善老年人的生活，助力“促进二次分配，实现共同富裕”的目标的完成。
4. 企业公益参与得到积极肯定：村民对企业参与公益事业持积极态度，认为这既是企业履行社会责任的表现，也是推动社会进步的重要动力。他们期待有更多企业能投入到公益及社会服务中来。
5. 发展期待与建议：村民希望项目能够长期持续，且不同人对服务的需求不尽相同，未来项目设计应当更加关注个体化和多样性，建议增加服务频率、范围和志愿者参与度，以覆盖更多需要帮助的老人，满足更广泛的需求；同时为保证项目的长期可持续运行，需要探索更多资金筹集的渠道，并逐步扩大服务范围，让更多的村民受益，保证项目的可持续发展。

1. 理大電子產品有限公司參加了香港貿易發展局主辦的香港春季電子產品展。 2. 學生扮演理大電子產品有限公司營業代表。
3. 老師扮演攤位參觀者。
4. 理大電子產品有限公司的營業代表向攤位參觀者推廣產品。 
5. 學生使用口語推廣產品。

產品說明(口語推銷)的結構: 1. 開場白 2. 產品/服務介紹 3. 結語。
開場白包括3個基本要素： 1. 打招呼: 內容可以很簡單，諸如「早上好」、「您好」等就可以了。 2. 通報姓名: 介紹自己的時候，一般先說企業名稱然後說出自己的名字和職位。3. 簡介企業業務範疇及自己的特長。
產品/服務介紹: 產品/服行銷最重要的事情是你告訴消費者，為什麼你需要我。所以，你應該用通俗易懂的語言直接地向對方闡述清楚：「產品的優點究竟會給對方帶來多少好處。」，創造需求→引發興趣→喚起欲望→採取行動。
結語: 是下一次溝通的開場白，應該要說出「跟對方打成一片、積極性的結語」，更重要是預埋伏筆，暗示對方採取接下來的行動。如果你能把目標與特長聯繫起來，更能激發對方聆聽的興趣。選擇結束語時，優先考慮的是如何調動對方的積 極性，激發對方參與互動的興趣是最重要的。

簡易產品資料框架: 產品的特點→產品特點帶來的功能→這些功能的優點→這些優點帶來的利益

要求: 
內容: 能夠根據指定目標和傳意對象適當地篩選推廣的內容，剪裁得宜，主次分明，詳略恰當。能夠條理分明、優次合宜地說明產品的特點，大大提高傳意效率。適當地運用例證豐富推廣的內容，突顯產品與消費者的關係，以加強說服力。
語言表達: 能夠完全代入設定的身份，以適當和靈活生動的語言和姿勢語進行推廣。
流程安排: 內容鋪排層次分明，有條不紊，輕重詳略安排得宜；並能準確控制時間。

產品說明技巧:
1. 定義說明: 技巧表達特點：言簡意賅。
2. 詮釋說明: 巧表達特點：通俗易懂。定義和詮釋之分別：定義力求高度概括，非常簡練，詮釋在語言表達上比定義詳盡而具體。
3. 分類說明: 技巧表達特點：條理井然。
4. 舉例說明: 技巧表達特點：事例典型，具體易明。
5. 比較說明: 表達技巧特點：印象鮮明深刻。
6. 比喻說明: 表達技巧特點：形象生動。
7. 數字說明: 表達技巧特點：具體精確。

課堂上討論的荆州棗紙簡，與《墨子·尚賢》相關文獻，主要是用來說明什麼原則？

	A.	
古書最後保留的內容常常是經過其所命名思想家（例如：「墨子」）的弟子、後代人以及歷史因素形塑的。不同流派常常對「墨子」本人的思想有不同的觀點。

	B.	
相關的出土竹書已經證明了《墨子·尚賢》上、中、下篇都與《墨子》原本的意思有迥然不同，所以世傳本《墨子》是扭曲墨子本人的思想。

	C.	
出土竹書經常嚴重損害，因此雖然有些參考價值，可是如荊州棗紙簡那般材料不能替代我們傳世的《墨子》等書。

	D.	
因為荆州棗紙簡很多內容與《老子》、《墨子》相關，因此證明了古代的思想家不但有辯論，也有合作的地方。

肺部炎症性疾病是一组以炎症反应异常为特征的呼吸系统疾病,包括急性肺损伤(ALI)、肺炎、哮喘、慢性阻塞性肺疾病(COPD)和肺纤维化等。这些疾病的共同点在于免疫系统失衡,导致炎症介质的过度释放,导致肺部损伤。在肺部损伤和修复过程中，初始的感染或损伤可引起固有免疫和适应性免疫的激活，以防御外来病原体。然而，长期的感染或复发性损伤可能触发持续性或慢性炎症，影响肺部组织的结构和功能。炎症是一系列复杂生物反应的总和，它能有效地清除侵入的微生物并促进受损组织的愈合，但炎症过程的失调亦可能导致组织损伤和病理状态的发展。因此，理解和调节炎症反应对于治疗肺部炎症性疾病具有重要意义。TREM2是一种免疫调节受体，主要表达在巨噬细胞和某些类型的树突细胞上，参与炎症反应的促进与抑制，还涉及清除细胞外碎片以及促进肺部组织的修复。发挥着调节免疫反应、促进细胞清除和维护组织稳态的功能。近年来的研究发现,TREM2在多种肺部炎症性疾病中的表达和活性发生改变,与疾病的发生发展密切相关。例如，在ALI、COPD和特发性肺纤维化（idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, IPF）等疾病中，TREM2的作用日益受到关注。因此，理解TREM2在这些炎症性肺疾病中的具体功能与作用机制，对于开发新的治疗策略和疾病的诊断意义重大。本文将系统阐述TREM2参与肺部炎症性疾病(ALI、COPD、哮喘和IPF)的机制和潜在临床意义,为相关疾病的诊断和治疗提供新的思路和靶点。                     请润色。

“아빠, 쵝오!”

나는 몸에 익은 익숙한 엄지척을 날려줬다.

“히잉.”

민국이가 실망하는 표정을 짓자 마음이 좀 안 좋았다.

“엄마가 챙겼지요!”

딩동.

아빠가 문을 열자 김미영이 들어왔다.

“그럼, 내일 점심으로 약속 확정할게요.”

“대표님, 점심 어디서 먹어요?”

나는 슬쩍 기대감에 젖어 물었다.

Once the Strawberry Laser light hits the fat or the adipocyte cells in this layer, a rapid chain of events takes place. Pores form on top of the fat cells, allowing them to release water, glycerol and fatty acids into the interstitial space located underneath the fatty layer of the skin. As the contents of the fat cells spill out, the adipocyte cells reduce in size.  This reaction does not affect any of the neighboring structures such as the skin, blood vessels or nerves and it is completely painless. The lymphatic system then does the rest of the work by removing the fat through the liver and kidneys, where it is processed and passed out in the urine. Next you will be measured in several places– we may use a marker/pen to ensure that the exact same area is measured every time you come in for treatment and before and after every treatment. Lastly, you will be photographed both before and after every treatment to help provide a visual to you and our specialists while tracking your inch-loss progress. The results are sure to stun you!

COOLSCULPTING®
Still have those lumps and bumps left over from weight gain despite diet and exercise? In the past, you might have had to resort to invasive liposuction or frequency devices to achieve that smooth look you really want. Today, CoolSculpting® offers a noninvasive, nonsurgical solution that offers very impressive results. 

HOW IT WORKS
CoolSculpting® uses a revolutionary new technology known as cryolipolysis. During the procedure, the fat cells are cooled to a temperature that will cause them to be completely eliminated from the body. The temperature used is much higher than anything that would harm skin, nerves, or muscle, making the entire process very safe to use.

TREATMENT
During this noninvasive procedure, a skin-protecting gel is first applied to the skin. The CoolSculpting® applicator is then positioned over that area, quickly cooling the fat cells until they are destroyed with very little discomfort. While the fat cells would be suctioned out of the body during liposuction, this procedure allows for the destroyed cells to be eliminated from the body naturally, dissipating slowly over a period of a few months. The entire process takes about an hour to complete.

RESULTS
The majority of patients who undergo this procedure will notice a difference in bulges after just a few weeks. This will continue to improve as the body eliminates the destroyed fat cells over the following couple of months. The skin over the treated areas will retract on its own since its elasticity was not tampered with during the procedure.

Typically, there is no need to begin a new diet or exercise program following CoolSculpting®. If you are already participating in a regular exercise regime and eating healthy, continuing to do so can only help your body heal faster and keep the fat deposits from reappearing. The majority of patients will only need to undergo one treatment per targeted area, and if a repeat is needed, it can be done within three months of the original treatment.

③ したがって, 『資本論』 においては,「ブルジョア社会の内的編制」をなす三範疇=「資本・土地所有・賃労働」の考察はそれらの基本的規定がすでにそこに与えられていることによって事実上は達成されている13), と。

It is ever thus. Novelists want us to understand their creations, or at least
their creatures. So they post road signs along the way, suggesting what we
should look for. Sarah Woodruff has her French lieutenant, the unlucky Mr.
Micawber his faith that something will turn up, and Jay Gatsby, of course, the
green light on Daisy’s dock. What is it, we ask, that Joe Christmas really wants?
How does what Pip wants differ from what he needs? Can he figure out the
difference? What does Jake Barnes not see when he looks at the mirror, and how
does it matter to the novel? Every character has his telos—Aristotle’s term for
the necessary endpoint in a goal-oriented, even compulsive, process—not the
place he actually winds up but the thing toward which he’s driven, his ultimate
goal. Our job is to find it. Are they always so obvious? Sadly, no. Will it explain
everything about him? Again, no. But it will explain a lot, and we need to find
out what drives the character if we want to know what drives the novel.
